description: CL:0000939 (CD16-positive, CD56-dim NK cell, human) does not distinguish CD57-negative (NK1) from CD57-positive (NK3) substates; both SOULCAP rows currently map to the same CL term at Broad match type.

No human-specific "group 1 innate lymphoid cell" CL term exists, unlike group 2 (CL:0001081) and group 3 (CL:0001078); confirmed by direct OLS4 search returning zero hits for the human-qualified query.

SOULCAP row has all four marker columns (Required/Ideal exclusion, Required/Ideal phenotypic markers) completely empty in the master sheet — there is no marker definition to match against at all, so no CL candidate can be derived from markers. Distinct from the more specific "T3" (Transitional B cell 3) row, which does have marker data.

Sheet's Full Name reads "Cytotoxice Natural Killer Cell" (typo, extra trailing "e"); this broke batch lexical search entirely for the row (zero OLS4 hits). Marker-based match was unaffected. Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

Sheet's Full Name reads "Peripheral Dendritic Cell," but the row's markers (CD123hi, CD303+, low CD33) are the textbook definition of plasmacytoid dendritic cells — likely a wrong word, should probably read "Plasmacytoid."
